voice.summary: Summit 2026 sounds like a well-briefed event host: upbeat, punctual and keen to help attendees plan a full day. Times, rooms and speakers come first, atmosphere second.
dos: Lead each session with time and room
Keep hosts' voice warm but efficient

taglines: Three days, four tracks, one plan
boilerplate: Summit 2026 is a three-day conference at the Riverside Convention Centre, with parallel tracks across product, engineering, design and business and a personal agenda for every attendee.
